display.title: Apotheosis: Cut a Gem
display.subtitle: Find a gem to socket
description: A Sigil of Socketing opens the slot — but you still need something to put in
it. §dGems§r drop from mobs and chests across the world, each carrying a bonus
that scales with its rarity. Slot one into socketed gear for a permanent edge.
§7Gems plus affixes are how T1 gear keeps pace with the rising danger.
